from pathlib import Path
p=Path("cache/docker-pkexec-bin")
p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
wrapper=p/"docker"
wrapper.write_text('#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexec pkexec /usr/bin/docker "$@"\n')
wrapper.chmod(0o700)
driver=Path("cache/dual-baseline.sh")
driver.write_text("""#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/vesanieminen/code/gpu-unlock-benchmarks
export PATH="$PWD/cache/docker-pkexec-bin:$PATH"
export BENCH_SYSTEM=dual-rtx3090
python3 record.py --system dual-rtx3090 --phase baseline-readiness -- bash -x -c 'test "$(systemctl is-active llama-swap.service)" = inactive; nvidia-smi'
python3 record.py --system dual-rtx3090 --phase preparation -- bash -x -c 'docker pull "$(cat image.lock)"'
bash run.sh download
BENCH_GPU=0 bash run.sh torch baseline-gpu0
BENCH_GPU=1 bash run.sh torch baseline-gpu1
BENCH_TP=2 bash run.sh vllm baseline
""")
driver.chmod(0o700)
print("Prepared ignored local Docker privilege wrapper and baseline driver")
